title: Lara's Labyrinth
specs: Most immersive escape room in San Diego
SEPTEMBER SPECIAL - Book 6 players for DaVinci or Sheepshank and bring 6 additional players for FREE
blurb: Lara's Labyrinth offers multiple immersive escape room experiences in San Diego, including rooms themed as Bewitched, Cannibal, The Heart of Bastet, Sheepshank Redemption, and The DaVinci Challenge. The site mentions seasonal specials, gift cards, and themed challenges for groups. A waiver is required for participation. Bookings are available for individuals and groups, and there are regular promotions for larger parties.
extraNote: There are absolutely no refunds. All sales are final. · You can reschedule your booking without any additional fee with three days' notice. · No credits or rescheduling within 3 days of your reservation if you only paid the deposit.
